database_tests.note: Incluye las dos comprobaciones opcionales de PostgreSQL.

checks: Overview uses live server and database status
Python executes and displays actual output in the editor
Snippet saves through the API into PostgreSQL
Ctrl+K finds and opens the library
Library exports a usable JSON file
Terminal WebSocket runs a real shell command
Terminal reconnects without a stale disconnected state
Every original module opens without crashing
AI honestly shows missing configuration without sending requests
Unknown routes have a useful recovery action
Desktop navigation has no uncaught JavaScript errors
Mobile menu navigates and closes; terminal has no page overflow
Mobile menu supports Escape and restores keyboard focus
Mobile overview scrolls to library and activity without runtime errors
Unavailable services and malformed neural-event data do not crash the app
